sourcePolicy: The complete 3.16 Git history is unchanged. Failed iteration logs were copied verbatim where a log file existed; no claim is made that every uncommitted intermediate mesh revision has a separate source snapshot. Final source is the reviewed vehicle.js with SHA256 2c5bd25456264409bcdd7c613e3fc1636e53c8973e552a99c6e5d691d30c1c0b.

iterations.failure: Existing surface test detected a smooth-strip normal seam.
iterations.resolution: Shared top/side boundary tangent and graph-normal assignment corrected.

iterations.failure: Existing geometry test detected zero/invalid normals at degenerate ruled edges.
iterations.resolution: Use the limiting interior derivative at a collapsed edge; retain finite unit normals.

iterations.failure: Existing geometry contract found only 100 qualifying interior side samples after too many rows were assigned to the shoulder band.
iterations.resolution: Redistribute the same vertex budget to a 20% shoulder / 80% door parameter range.

iterations.stage: frozen baseline loader in new test
iterations.failure: Sandbox rejected the Git child with spawnSync git EPERM, despite available restored data.
iterations.resolution: Run the read-only restored-Git regression with the permitted execution context.

iterations.failure: The initial harness required visual-presets.js to equal 3.16, but the parallel city work had legitimately changed that file. This was a test harness dependency assumption, not a model failure.
iterations.evidenceSource: Retained tool return; the first redirect captured stdout only, so the error itself is transcribed here instead of claiming an original stderr file.
iterations.toolErrorExcerpt: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Frozen geometry shared dependency changed: visual-presets.js; actual e04bf7f7b38fea0a8256415873af6820a3bbee3dcd5dc44ee65bd15de561e20e; expected 29e63a9677714ee0770b0ae13f27a629e7676fccfbb899afc5b25a32c95d0b88
iterations.resolution: Import the frozen vehicle with its actual frozen leaf dependencies, and share only the byte-identical THREE module.
